x: There was a very keen race for the first three places between Poole (Worcester), Hutchison (Met) and Hawkins (Met) who eventually finished in that order, whilst Eric Hall, continuing his form finished 5th.
236 lined up for the start and Vickers and Hall were seen to be well placed shortly afterwards behind Hardy, Coleman, Hawkins, Poole and others.

Although we just missed a place in the scratch team event, Eric Hall walked exceedingly well to finish in fourth position behind three really first class walkers in Hawkins, Coleman and Poole on a course which is probably the fastest one in the south.
Hawkins, Poole and Huthison set a fast pace from the start with our Eric running well behind them. In next position came yours truly smothered from top to toe in grease.
At the 20 k.metres Hutchison and Johnson had gone into the lead at a very fast pace closely followed by Thompson and with Hawkins of the Met. in 4th place we began to wonder what was going to happen.
For the first time Metropolitan W.C. sent a strong team for this race and Hawkins, Hutchison and Nigel Thompson battled for the first three placings the whole way, eventually finishing in that order.
Hardy and Allen of Sheffield quickly took the lead at a fast pace, followed by Stan, Coleman and Hawkins. Allen soon came under the judges ban and was disqualified.
Wiseman took 2nd place, with 3rd hotly disputed between E.Hawkins and N.Berry both with 14 pts, Hawkins taking it on highest position, although N.Berry had competed in every event.
